function.name: search_google
function.description: Performs a search query on Google and returns a list of URLs that match the search criteria. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

query.description: The search term to query on Google.

num_results.description: The maximum number of search results to return. The number must be a positive integer.

language.description: The language for the search results.

filter.description: A flag to filter explicit content in search results.

date_range.description: The date range for the search results in the format 'MM/DD/YYYY-MM/DD/YYYY'. If not specified, searches across all dates.

message.content:
Here’s a quick snapshot of the most prominent vaccine manufacturers around the world (as of 2026). These companies produce a wide range of vaccines—from routine childhood immunizations to specialty and pandemic vaccines.

| Company | Headquarters | Notable Vaccines | Key Strengths |
|---------|--------------|------------------|---------------|
| **Pfizer‑BioNTech** | New York, USA / Mainz, Germany | COVID‑19 mRNA vaccine (Comirnaty), HPV, influenza | Leading mRNA platform; rapid development & scale‑up |
| **Moderna** | Cambridge, USA | COVID‑19 mRNA vaccine (Spikevax), RSV, influenza | Pioneer mRNA technology; strong pipeline |
| **Johnson & Johnson (Janssen)** | New Jersey, USA | COVID‑19 single‑dose adenovirus vector, meningococcal, HPV | Adenovirus vector expertise; single‑dose delivery |
| **AstraZeneca** | Cambridge, UK | COVID‑19 adenovirus vector, HPV, influenza | Global distribution network; low‑cost production |
| **Novavax** | Gaithersburg, USA | COVID‑19 protein subunit, influenza | Protein subunit platform; high efficacy |
| **GlaxoSmithKline (GSK)** | Brentford, UK | HPV, influenza, pneumococcal, rotavirus | Broad portfolio; strong R&D in adjuvants |
| **Sanofi Pasteur** | Paris, France | HPV, influenza, meningococcal, typhoid | Large global manufacturing footprint |
| **Merck & Co. (MSD)** | Kenilworth, USA | HPV, influenza, varicella, MMR | Strong vaccine pipeline; global reach |
| **Bharat Biotech** | Hyderabad, India | COVID‑19 recombinant protein (Covaxin), hepatitis B | Rapid domestic production; cost‑effective |
| **COVAXIN (Bharat Biotech + ICMR)** | India | COVID‑19 whole‑virus inactivated | First Indian COVID‑19 vaccine |
| **Sinovac Biotech** | Beijing, China | COVID‑19 inactivated (CoronaVac), influenza | Inactivated virus platform; large domestic market |
| **Sinopharm (China National Pharmaceutical Group)** | Beijing, China | COVID‑19 inactivated (BBIBP‑CorV), influenza | State‑backed; extensive domestic distribution |
| **Biontech (German subsidiary of Pfizer)** | Mainz, Germany | COVID‑19 mRNA (Comirnaty) | European manufacturing hub |
| **Celltrion** | Seoul, South Korea | COVID‑19 protein subunit (COVAXIN‑like) | Strong biologics manufacturing |
| **Takeda Pharmaceutical** | Tokyo, Japan | Hepatitis B, rotavirus, influenza | Global presence; strong R&D |
| **Boehringer Ingelheim** | Ingelheim, Germany | Influenza, rabies, tetanus | Established biologics manufacturing |
| **Serum Institute of India** | Pune, India | Polio, measles‑rubella, hepatitis B, influenza | Largest vaccine manufacturer by volume |
| **Eli Lilly & Co.** | Indianapolis, USA | HPV, influenza, hepatitis B | Strong R&D; global distribution |
| **Bayer AG** | Leverkusen, Germany | HPV, influenza, hepatitis B | Integrated pharma & biotech operations |
| **Mylan (now Viatris)** | Dublin, Ireland | HPV, influenza, rotavirus | Global generics & specialty vaccine production |

### How to Use This List
- **Research**: If you’re looking into vaccine development or procurement, this table gives you a starting point for potential partners or competitors.
- **Supply Chain**: For logistics or supply chain planning, note the geographic spread and manufacturing hubs.
- **Regulatory**: Each company has different regulatory approvals (e.g., WHO prequalification, FDA, EMA). Check their status for specific vaccines if you need compliance info.

If you need deeper details—such as current pipeline projects, recent clinical trial data, or financial performance—just let me know which companies or vaccines you’re most interested in!
